title.zh: DNA 复制与翻译 · 拉链、抄写和流水线
title.en: DNA Replication and Translation · A Zipper, a Copy and an Assembly Line

desc.zh: 碱基像拉链两两配对；复制时每条链都当模板，抄写出 mRNA，核糖体再按密码子一格一格造出蛋白质。
desc.en: Bases pair up like a zipper; in replication each strand is a template, transcription copies a gene into mRNA, and the ribosome builds a protein codon by codon.
